name: Brenkey
look: a squat little blue monkey with a big round head, an orange heart-shaped face, a bored stare, a white chest tuft, a bamboo straw and a spiral tail
entry: It sips water up through its bamboo straw and squirts it at anyone who bothers it. It acts tough, but it would much rather be napping.
how: One of the second A. Fakemon trio's starters: pick it at the starter screen (its A. Fakemon II page).
Wild: very rare in jungles and on beaches.
